summary: Frontend-only visual verification of mobile layout bug fix in Dashboard.jsx (sticky bottom RecipesStrip + StylePresets + PromptDock). Tested at mobile 412x915, tablet 768x1024, and desktop 1920x900. The gradient backdrop (rgba(3,7,18,0.4)->1.0) + backdrop-filter blur(24px) + z-20 on parent sticky wrapper are all correctly applied. No text from EmptyState FeatureCard components bleeds through the sticky chip rows. Interactive regressions verified: recipe chip click populates textarea (223 chars), style chip toggles active state, COMPARE toggle switches PromptDock to multi-model selection (3/4), textarea accepts input. No regression at tablet/desktop viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly applies gradient + backdrop-filter + z-20 to the sticky wrapper — verified via computed styles: background='linear-gradient(rgba(3,7,18,0.4) 0%, rgba(3,7,18,0.9) 12%, rgba(3,7,18,0.98) 30%, rgb(3,7,18) 100%)', backdropFilter='blur(24px)', parent position=sticky with z-index=20.
Bounding boxes confirm sticky area at y=629-891 correctly overlays last feature card (y=685-807) with an opaque backdrop covering the overlap zone (gradient is ~90%+ opaque at y=685).
Bottom padding pb-56 md:pb-48 on ChatView container is appropriate for the height of the sticky wrapper (~262px on mobile, less on desktop).

Minor: gradient top edge at 40% opacity means the very first ~4px of the RicetteStrip row can show a faint bleed of whatever is behind, but this is imperceptible in practice and doesn't affect the reported bug.
Minor: pointer-events-none on the outer sticky div plus pointer-events-auto on the inner is a good pattern to avoid blocking sidebar scroll while still keeping chips interactive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile visual bug (chips bleed-through) is FIXED and verified at 412x915. The gradient + blur + z-20 combination is functioning. For any future changes to sticky bottom area, re-verify: (1) computed style has both gradient background AND backdrop-filter, (2) parent has position:sticky with z-index >= 20, (3) at mobile 412px, last feature card y-bottom is ABOVE recipes-strip y-top OR is fully covered by the gradient opaque region. Recipe/style/compare/textarea interactions verified.
rca of the issue: Original bug: sticky bottom wrapper had NO background — since it uses `sticky` positioning (in-flow), transparent chips visually overlapped the scrolling feature cards behind them on mobile where vertical space is tighter (412x915). Fix: added gradient background + backdrop-filter blur + z-20 to the pointer-events-auto inner div so the sticky area is now a visually opaque layer above scrolling content, and increased ChatView bottom padding to pb-56 md:pb-48 so response cards don't hide behind the sticky wrapper when scrolling.
